name: empower-jhang-workspace
description: Root workspace to manage frontend and backend concurrently

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend
scripts.dev: npx concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "Backend,Frontend" -c "yellow.bold,cyan.bold" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
